summary: Wooded, near-flat east kerb where cars park; homes 18-25 m off.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 18-25 m on the east side; trees and a tennis court screen the nearest; houses within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; five or six cars parked at the north end, so some verge room exists.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs are 2P resident permit Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Construction building 17 m away near 112 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the best section; shaded much of the day.
cannot_judge: Room to stop clear of the lane

best_section.where: East kerb in the low dip under trees, south of the cul-de-sac turn
